mapper.select: SELECT workout_set_id, workout_exercise_id, set_no, weight, reps, memo FROM workout_sets WHERE workout_exercise_id = #{workoutExerciseId} ORDER BY set_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workout_sets ( workout_set_id, workout_exercise_id, set_no, weight, reps, memo ) VALUES ( SEQ_WORKOUT_SETS.NEXTVAL, #{workoutExerciseId}, #{setNo}, #{weight,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{reps}, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
